pretreatments.description: Milling of the dried pine needles in an electric blender to size reduction to a 20 mesh size
Steam explosion of pine needles by autoclaving at 121 °C for 30 min in a flask plugged with non-absorbent cotton
Acid-base-acid pretreatment involving repeated exposure to acid (HCl) and alkali (NaOH) with a 30 min cycle, followed by washings with water until neutral pH of the wash out liquid was obtained
